items.title: Dalton Richards Interview, 1961-03-16
items.q: So the whole family knew Steve Lewis.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. Because my sister— Four nineteen and eight then?

Yes. My sister, it was a Sharma. And it was a heavy thing, and when we moved on Broadway Street in the house, it was too heavy to bring up stairs, so we left it in the basement. And I used to play it, and practice on it, and play it, and practice on it, until the strings couldn't stand anymore. They told me the only thing that'd be done, left to be done with the piano was to have it restrown. I thought it was too expensive. Yeah. I sold it for $25. Sold it for $25. And get settled. Now, my youngest sister is a…
Oh yes. I never got to hear him, but I knew all that I played with Theron.
